pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, nav background, icon fills

fog-mist.$description: Fog Mist — Footer surface, secondary card tint, alternating section backgrounds

paper-gray.$description: Paper Gray — Opened nav menu surface — barely-distinguished from white canvas

silver-smoke.$description: Silver Smoke — Tertiary surface, subtle dividers, chip backgrounds

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Hairline separators, disabled button backgrounds

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary body text, captions, helper labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Nav text, secondary nav and link text

steel.$description: Steel — Nav icon fills, button text on light surfaces, dark surface tint

near-black.$description: Near Black — Headlines, primary body text, all editorial copy — the dominant ink

true-black.$description: True Black — Icon fills, input underline, maximum-emphasis headings

apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Primary action fill — the only chromatic button color, also nav hover and focus ring

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Inline text link color, secondary link accent

ember.$description: Ember — Orange state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

ocean-depth.$description: Ocean Depth — Hero gradient stop — deep blue anchoring the product spotlight wash

sf-pro-text.$description: Body, navigation, micro-copy, and smaller headings. 17px/400 for primary body (line-height 1.47), 14px/600 for eyebrow labels and small link lists, 12px/400 for legal and fine print, 44px/400 for nav bar text, 34px/600 for card sub-headings.

sf-pro-display.$description: Display and editorial headlines — 80px hero, 56px section opener, 48px feature, 28px sub-feature, 21px large body. Negative letter-spacing tightens as size increases (-0.015em at 80px down to 0.011em at 21px). The only family used at sizes ≥ 40px.

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
